findings.title: Model router call log file is missing

evidence.observation: router_status reports log file path at /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl but call_log_exists is false and call_log_size_mb is null

proposed_action.description: Ensure the model router process initializes and persists the call_log.jsonl file properly or check permissions and path configuration.

findings.expected_benefit: Enables latency tracking, routing observability, and auditability for all LLM calls across the platform.

findings.title: Emergency alert module bypasses centralized model router via direct API calls

evidence.observation: Direct invocations of call_gemini and call_mistral reading raw environment variables instead of routing through the model router port 8891

proposed_action.description: Refactor emergency alert generation to request completions via the centralized model router.

findings.expected_benefit: Prevents silent failures, ensures centralized logging, fallback management, and adherence to routing policies.

findings.title: Unimplemented Phase 5 placeholders in research command and quality forecasting
